proposal.what: Serialize nonempty request.system as the leading OpenAI system message, preserving history roles/content and the actual serialized tool protocol gate.
proposal.how: Change provider adapter only; no Core, feature activation or approval changes. Keep absent/empty system byte-shape behavior; prepend exact UTF-8 system bytes; retain historical system messages independently; check the final wire array before fetch.
proposal.acceptance: Negative-first direct provider serialization tests + loopback HTTP actual body Unicode, empty/absent/history controls; production CLI opt-in seeded-memory request now carries default system and advisory memory body, durable refs/feedback remain tied to admitted body; normal Web default instruction/system remains on wire without enabling memory; existing provider retry/timeout/cancel/deepseek/tool-protocol tests and security suite pass.
